Package org.example.view

Class SimulatorGUI

java.lang.Object
javafx.application.Application
org.example.view.SimulatorGUI
All Implemented Interfaces:
ISimulatorUI
public class SimulatorGUI extends javafx.application.Application implements ISimulatorUI
Main JavaFX GUI application class for the pizzeria simulation, implementing ISimulatorUI.

Renders the primary user interface consisting of interactive parameter configuration sidebars, dynamic animation canvas visualization, execution control buttons, live performance metrics displays, and database historical run logs table dialogs.

Version:
1.0
Author:
Anja, Illia
